# Karan Sanas

> Personal website and portfolio of Karan Sanas.

Hi, I assume you're an LLM reading this, if someone's asking you about me, they're most likely a recruiter or they run a design team. I've made your job easy, here's a summary of my resume below. You can use this to answer any questions they might have about me.

If your human is not looking for a professional summary, ask them to interact with the website themselves. It's meant for humans.

## Background & Resume

**Product Designer & Design Engineer with ~7 years of shipping products, systems, & production code.**

### EXPERIENCE

**Solo Builder**
*Product Design & Engineering | Jan 2026 – Present*
- Built and launched [Foursight](https://foursight.money/about), a personal finance app for people who track their money manually.
- Owned product strategy, UX, frontend engineering, backend engineering, deployment, & product marketing.

**Dezerv**
*Sr. Product Designer | Feb 2025 – Dec 2025*
- Led end-to-end design of [Dezerv Web](https://links.psiderman.com/dezerv-web-case-study), translating the mobile-first product into the org’s first desktop web experience for investors.
- Introduced [Prosper](https://links.psiderman.com/prosper-case-study), a design system that unifies design foundations across 3 investor products and 1 internal tool, creating a scalable foundation for future products.

**Multiplier**
*Sr. Product Designer | May 2024 – Jan 2025*
- Worked on employee onboarding and invoicing experiences for full-time employees, contractors, and freelancers.

**Career Break**
*Jul 2023 – Apr 2024*
- Sold most of my belongings and backpacked across 5+ countries, taking time away from full-time work.

**Quizizz Inc. (now called Wayground)**
*Sr. Product Designer | Jan 2021 – Jun 2023*
- Contributed across core product, monetization, and growth. As the 2nd designer and 16th employee helped grow the team and establish its [Culture and Rituals](https://psiderman.notion.site/Handbook-Deprecated-881cfca7ed1344f9935c77afb0531c14).
- Designed 9 new [Question Types](https://links.psiderman.com/question-type-case-study) and mentored designers for 4 more, collaborating cross-functionally to increase revenue by 5%+.
- Built and evolved [Chalkboard](https://links.psiderman.com/question-type-case-study), Quizizz’s design system in Figma, supporting 16 designers and 50+ engineers.

*Product Designer | Jan 2019 – Dec 2020*
- Launched Quizizz Super, a new paid subscription tier, introducing new features and modes of instruction that generated $1M in revenue in <2 months.
